transport_options.description: Excellent, straightforward metro. Line 2 goes to Haeundae Beach; Line 1 goes to Nampo, Jagalchi and Gamcheon access (via Toseong Station). Seomyeon Station is the interchange for Lines 1 & 2.

transport_options.description: To reach Gamcheon Culture Village, take Saha 1-1, Saha 1 or Seogu 2 from Toseong Station Exit 6

transport_options.description: Useful occasionally for Gamcheon Culture Village and coastal areas
transport_options.how_to_use: Always tap when boarding and when exiting
